title: Polyoxometalate-based all-inorganic open frameworks
claim: POM-based all-inorganic open frameworks are still an early field: structural diversity is narrow and dominated by tungstates, synthesis is mostly conventional solution or hydrothermal/solvothermal chemistry, and many properties remain unexamined.
explanation: The outlook notes that polyoxotantalate analogues are unknown and that POMo, POV, and PONb SBUs are underused relative to POW. It calls for ionothermal and surfactant-thermal methods beyond solution, hydrothermal, and solvothermal routes, and for studies of chiral, biological, antibacterial, and molecular-sensing behavior that have not been extensively explored.
scope: The family of POM-based all-inorganic open frameworks as surveyed through this review.
caveats: These are gaps in the reported literature as judged by the authors, not evidence that the missing clusters, methods, or properties are inaccessible.
